title: The starter is the bakery
thesis: The slow invisible part of the work decides the result, long before anyone sees it.

nodes.text: The bakery and its starter: if the starter is weak, the loaves come out flat and sour and nobody can fix that at the oven (transcript line 5).
The month of feeding the starter begins: work that will show nothing for weeks.
The long, unseen middle: the month goes on with nothing to show, set against the eleven years of notebooks.
Whose notebooks are the eleven years, and what do they record? The brief names them but doesn't say.
"That was the moment she knew he would be good." (transcript line 9): the slow work is recognised before any loaf proves it.
Who are she and he, and what happened in that moment? The brief quotes the line but not the scene.
Hand it to the team lead: the slow invisible part of the work decided the result (transcript line 11). Leave the reader to protect it, and don't explain the story back to them.
